citation.authors: Hernandez AM, Smith SJ, Vahora MS, Campbell D et al

record.population: Seven cohort studies and one case-control study in US Black women
record.design: Systematic review of hair relaxer use and reproductive and breast outcomes
record.finding: The authors conclude that the weight of the evidence does not support relaxers being a risk factor for gynaecological and breast cancers in US Black women. They note one study found a statistically significant link with fibroids and that none of the studies characterised the chemical constituents.
record.note: Counter-evidence. Funding and conflicts not checked; relaxers are the subject of litigation (per the 12 Nov research file), so independence is UNVERIFIED.
